    for(const list of by.values()){if(list.length<3)continue;before+=list.length;after++;
      const g=mergeGeos(list.map(c=>{c.updateMatrix();return [c.geometry,c.matrix];}));g.computeBoundingSphere();
      const me=new THREE.Mesh(g,list[0].material);me.castShadow=list[0].castShadow;me.receiveShadow=list[0].receiveShadow;for(const c of list)grp.remove(c);grp.add(me);}}
  V33.merged=[before,after,Math.round(performance.now()-t0)];}catch(e){V33.err.push('juntar '+e.message);}},120);

// ====================== V34 · Kit de arquitetura colonial (o mesmo acabamento do Paço, reaproveitável) ======================
// Paredes com vãos reais, cantaria, esquadrias, sacadas, telhados de capa e canal, desgaste pintado por edifício.
// Usa as texturas e as vidraças do Paço (V33) para não carregar nada em dobro.
function ARQ34(G,seed){
 const K={},TX=V33.TX,T=.6;
 let s0=seed||1808;const R=()=>{s0=(s0*1103515245+12345)&0x7fffffff;return s0/0x7fffffff;};K.R=R;
 const memo=fn=>{const c=new Map();return (...a)=>{const k=JSON.stringify(a);let g=c.get(k);if(!g){g=fn(...a);c.set(k,g);}return g;};};
 const M4=K.M4=(x=0,y=0,z=0,ry=0,sx=1,sy=1,sz=1,rx=0,rz=0)=>new THREE.Matrix4().compose(new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z),new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(rx,ry,rz)),new THREE.Vector3(sx,sy,sz));
 const mul=K.mul=(a,b)=>new THREE.Matrix4().multiplyMatrices(a,b);
 const boxG=K.boxG=memo((w,h,d)=>new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,d));
 const bevelBox=K.bevelBox=memo((w,h,d,b=.025)=>{const s=new THREE.Shape();s.moveTo(-w/2,-h/2);s.lineTo(w/2,-h/2);s.lineTo(w/2,h/2);s.lineTo(-w/2,h/2);s.lineTo(-w/2,-h/2);
   const g=new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s,{depth:Math.max(.001,d-2*b),bevelEnabled:true,bevelThickness:b,bevelSize:b,bevelSegments:1,steps:1});g.translate(0,0,-(d-2*b)/2);return g;});
 // vão: verga em arco abatido (rise>0), pleno (rise<0) ou reto (rise=0)
 const opening=K.opening=(p,x0,x1,yb,yt,rise)=>{const xc=(x0+x1)/2,r=(x1-x0)/2;p.moveTo(x0,yb);p.lineTo(x1,yb);
   if(rise<0){p.lineTo(x1,yt-r);p.absarc(xc,yt-r,r,0,Math.PI,false);}else if(rise>0){p.lineTo(x1,yt-rise);p.quadraticCurveTo(xc,yt+rise,x0,yt-rise);}else{p.lineTo(x1,yt);p.lineTo(x0,yt);}p.lineTo(x0,yb);return p;};
 const circleHole=(p,x,y,r)=>{p.absarc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2,false);return p;};
 const moulding=K.moulding=memo((pts,len)=>{const s=new THREE.Shape();s.moveTo(0,pts[0][1]);for(const [a,b] of pts)s.lineTo(a,b);s.lineTo(0,pts[pts.length-1][1]);
   const g=new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s,{depth:len,bevelEnabled:false,steps:1,curveSegments:4});g.rotateY(-Math.PI/2);g.translate(len/2,0,0);return g;});
 K.P={CORNICE:[[0,-.02],[.06,0],[.06,.07],[.12,.1],[.16,.16],[.2,.2],[.27,.23],[.33,.27],[.38,.31],[.44,.34],[.48,.38],[.48,.45],[0,.45]],
   BAND:[[0,0],[.07,0],[.07,.05],[.1,.08],[.1,.16],[.07,.19],[0,.21]],PLINTH:[[0,-.3],[.09,-.3],[.09,.78],[.06,.86],[.03,.9],[0,.92]],
   SILL:[[0,0],[.16,0],[.18,.03],[.18,.09],[.14,.12],[0,.12]],LINTEL:[[0,0],[.05,.02],[.09,.06],[.14,.1],[.16,.16],[.16,.2],[0,.2]]};
 // ---------- materiais (pedra, lioz, madeira, ferro: compartilhados entre edifícios) ----------
 const mStd=K.mStd=o=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial(Object.assign({roughness:.9,metalness:0},o));
 const SH=V33.SH=V33.SH||{stone:mStd({map:TX.stone,normalMap:TX.stoneN,normalScale:new THREE.Vector2(.42,.42),color:0xb9b0a0,roughness:.88}),
   marble:mStd({map:TX.stone,normalMap:TX.stoneN,normalScale:new THREE.Vector2(.45,.45),color:0xfff8ec,roughness:.6}),
   wood:mStd({map:TX.wood,normalMap:TX.woodN,normalScale:new THREE.Vector2(.6,.6),roughness:.78}),
   woodBrown:mStd({map:TX.wood,normalMap:TX.woodN,normalScale:new THREE.Vector2(.6,.6),color:0x8a5a3a,roughness:.8}),
   iron:mStd({color:0x232220,roughness:.55,metalness:.55}),dark:new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x120f0c,side:THREE.BackSide}),
   tile:mStd({map:TX.tile,roughness:.82,side:THREE.DoubleSide}),under:mStd({color:0x5a2e1c,roughness:1}),
   bronze:mStd({color:0x7a5a2a,roughness:.4,metalness:.75}),glow:new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x2e2216}),vfloor:mStd({color:0x2a231d,roughness:.9})};
 K.SH=SH;
 // ---------- atlas de desgaste do edifício ----------
 const ATL=2048,wcv=document.createElement('canvas'),bcv=document.createElement('canvas');wcv.width=wcv.height=bcv.width=bcv.height=1024;
 const wc=wcv.getContext('2d'),bc=bcv.getContext('2d');wc.fillStyle='#fff';wc.fillRect(0,0,1024,1024);bc.fillStyle='#000';bc.fillRect(0,0,1024,1024);
 const wTex=new THREE.CanvasTexture(wcv),bTex=new THREE.CanvasTexture(bcv);
 const PXM=44;let shelfX=0,shelfY=0,shelfH=0;const rects=[];
 const alloc=(len,h)=>{let w=Math.ceil(len*PXM),hh=Math.ceil(h*PXM);if(w>ATL){const k=ATL/w;w=ATL;hh=Math.ceil(hh*k);}if(shelfX+w>ATL){shelfX=0;shelfY+=shelfH+4;shelfH=0;}const r=[shelfX,shelfY,w,hh];shelfX+=w+4;shelfH=Math.max(shelfH,hh);return r;};
 const plaster=mStd({map:TX.plaster,normalMap:TX.plasterN,normalScale:new THREE.Vector2(.28,.28),color:0xfbf6ec,roughness:.95});
 plaster.onBeforeCompile=sh=>{sh.uniforms.wMap={value:wTex};sh.uniforms.bMap={value:bTex};sh.uniforms.brk={value:TX.brick};
   sh.vertexShader=sh.vertexShader.replace('#include <common>','#include <common>\nattribute vec2 wuv;\nvarying vec2 vW;').replace('#include <uv_vertex>','#include <uv_vertex>\nvW=wuv;');
   sh.fragmentShader=sh.fragmentShader.replace('#include <common>','#include <common>\nuniform sampler2D wMap;uniform sampler2D bMap;uniform sampler2D brk;\nvarying vec2 vW;')
    .replace('#include <map_fragment>','#include <map_fragment>\n{vec3 w=texture2D(wMap,vW).rgb;float b=smoothstep(.35,.65,texture2D(bMap,vW).r);vec3 bc=pow(texture2D(brk,vUv*1.5).rgb,vec3(2.2));bc=mix(vec3(dot(bc,vec3(.3,.55,.15))),bc,.7)*.75;diffuseColor.rgb=mix(diffuseColor.rgb*w*w,bc,b);}');};
 plaster.customProgramCacheKey=()=>'arq34plaster';K.plaster=plaster;
 // ---------- coleta de peças ----------
 const parts={},wallGeos=[],paintJobs=[];K.parts=parts;
 const put=K.put=(key,geo,m4)=>{(parts[key]=parts[key]||[]).push([geo,m4||new THREE.Matrix4()]);};
 // parede: forma (retângulo ou contorno dado), vãos, quadro local → edifício; outer face em z=0, espessura para dentro
 K.wall=(o)=>{const {len,y0,y1,holes=[],m4,outline,circles=[],thick=T,paint=true}=o;
   const s=new THREE.Shape();if(outline){s.moveTo(outline[0][0],outline[0][1]);for(const p of outline.slice(1))s.lineTo(p[0],p[1]);if(o.curve)o.curve(s);s.closePath&&0;}
   else{s.moveTo(-len/2,y0);s.lineTo(len/2,y0);s.lineTo(len/2,y1);s.lineTo(-len/2,y1);s.lineTo(-len/2,y0);}
   for(const h of holes){const p=new THREE.Path();opening(p,h.x-h.w/2,h.x+h.w/2,Math.max(h.yb,y0+.001),h.yt,h.rise);s.holes.push(p);}
   for(const c of circles){const p=new THREE.Path();circleHole(p,c.x,c.y,c.r);s.holes.push(p);}
   const g=new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s,{depth:thick,bevelEnabled:false,curveSegments:10,steps:1});g.translate(0,0,-thick);
   const top=o.ytop||y1,rect=alloc(len,top-y0),[rx,ry,rw,rh]=rect,p=g.attributes.position,uv=g.attributes.uv,w=new Float32Array(p.count*2);
   for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){const x=p.getX(i),y=p.getY(i);uv.setXY(i,uv.getX(i)/1.7,uv.getY(i)/1.7);w[i*2]=(rx+(x+len/2)/len*rw)/ATL;w[i*2+1]=1-(ry+(top-y)/(top-y0)*rh)/ATL;}
   g.setAttribute('wuv',new THREE.BufferAttribute(w,2));g.applyMatrix4(m4);wallGeos.push(g);if(paint)paintJobs.push({rect,len,y0,y1:top,cornice:y1,holes,tint:o.tint});};
 // ---------- vãos: molduras de cantaria, esquadrias, vidraças, grades, sacadas ----------
 const frameRing=K.frameRing=memo((o,b,depth)=>{const s=new THREE.Shape(),x0=-o.w/2,x1=o.w/2;opening(s,x0-b,x1+b,o.yb-.06,o.yt+b*(o.rise<0?1:.85),o.rise<0?-1:o.rise);
   const h=new THREE.Path();opening(h,x0,x1,o.yb,o.yt,o.rise);s.holes.push(h);return new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s,{depth,bevelEnabled:true,bevelThickness:.015,bevelSize:.015,bevelSegments:1,curveSegments:10});});
 const woodRing=memo((o,inset)=>{const s=new THREE.Shape();opening(s,-o.w/2,o.w/2,o.yb,o.yt,o.rise);const h=new THREE.Path();opening(h,-o.w/2+.06,o.w/2-.06,o.yb+.06,o.yt-.06,o.rise);s.holes.push(h);
   const g=new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s,{depth:.08,bevelEnabled:false,curveSegments:8});g.translate(0,0,-inset-.04);return g;});
 const glassFor=memo((o,inset,v)=>{const s=new THREE.Shape();opening(s,-o.w/2,o.w/2,o.yb,o.yt,o.rise);const g=new THREE.ShapeGeometry(s,8);const ox=(v%2)*.5,oy=v<2?.5:0,uv=g.attributes.uv,p=g.attributes.position;
   for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++)uv.setXY(i,ox+(p.getX(i)+o.w/2)/o.w*.5,oy+(p.getY(i)-o.yb)/(o.yt-o.yb)*.5);g.translate(0,0,-inset);return g;});
 const railing=memo(w=>{const L=[];const rail=(y,th)=>L.push([boxG(w,th,th),M4(0,y,0)]);rail(.95,.045);rail(.08,.035);rail(.82,.022);rail(.22,.022);
   const n=Math.round(w/.11);for(let i=0;i<=n;i++)L.push([boxG(.018,.87,.018),M4(-w/2+i*w/n,.51,0)]);
   for(const s of[-1,1]){L.push([boxG(.05,.95,.05),M4(s*w/2,.48,0)]);L.push([new THREE.SphereGeometry(.04,6,4),M4(s*w/2,1.0,0)]);}
   const nS=Math.max(2,Math.round(w/.36));for(let i=0;i<nS;i++){const x=-w/2+(i+.5)*w/nS;for(const s of[-1,1])L.push([new THREE.TorusGeometry(.07,.008,4,10,Math.PI*1.3),M4(x+s*.055,.52+s*.08,0,0,1,1,1,0,s>0?Math.PI*.15:Math.PI*1.15)]);}
   return mergeGeos(L);});
 const corbelG=K.corbelG=(()=>{const s=new THREE.Shape();s.moveTo(0,0);s.lineTo(.04,0);s.bezierCurveTo(.08,-.08,.22,-.06,.24,-.16);s.bezierCurveTo(.26,-.26,.14,-.32,.06,-.36);s.lineTo(0,-.38);s.lineTo(0,0);
   const g=new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s,{depth:.12,bevelEnabled:true,bevelThickness:.01,bevelSize:.01,bevelSegments:1,curveSegments:6});g.rotateY(-Math.PI/2);g.translate(.06,0,0);return g;})();
 const grille=memo(o=>{const L=[],n=Math.round(o.w/.13);for(let i=1;i<n;i++)L.push([boxG(.02,o.yt-o.yb-.15,.02),M4(-o.w/2+i*o.w/n,(o.yb+o.yt)/2-.05,-.1)]);for(const y of[o.yb+.45,o.yb+1.2])L.push([boxG(o.w,.03,.025),M4(0,y,-.1)]);return mergeGeos(L);});
 // porta aberta para dentro, com vestíbulo escuro (e um brilho ao fundo, quando houver)
 K.openDoor=(o,m4,depth=3.2,glow=true,woodKey='wood')=>{const yb=o.yb||0,hh=o.yt-yb,leafW=o.w/2,leafH=hh-(o.rise<0?o.w/2*.3:.1);
   for(const s of[-1,1]){const hx=s*o.w/2,base=mul(m4,M4(hx,yb,-T*.55,-s*Math.PI/2));put(woodKey,bevelBox(leafW-.02,leafH,.09,.015),mul(base,M4(-s*leafW/2,leafH/2,0)));
     for(const y of[.8,leafH*.55+.4,leafH-.45])put(woodKey,bevelBox(leafW*.7,Math.min(.9,leafH*.25),.06,.02),mul(base,M4(-s*leafW/2,y,.05)));}
   put('dark',boxG(o.w+.3,hh+.5,depth),mul(m4,M4(0,yb+(hh+.5)/2-.02,-T-depth/2+.02)));
   put('vfloor',boxG(o.w+.28,.06,depth+T*.7),mul(m4,M4(0,yb+.03,-T*.3-depth/2)));
   if(glow){const s=new THREE.Shape();opening(s,-o.w*.22,o.w*.22,0,hh*.6,-1);const g=new THREE.ShapeGeometry(s,10);put('glow',g,mul(m4,M4(0,yb+.06,-T-depth+.06)));}};
 K.openings=(list,m4F)=>{for(const oo of list){if(oo.kind==='porta-aberta'||oo.kind==='none'||oo.kind==='portal')continue;const o={...oo,x:0},m4=mul(m4F,M4(oo.x,0,0));
   put('stone',frameRing(o,o.big?.26:(o.b||.2),.1),m4);
   if(o.kind==='grade'||o.kind==='janela')put('stone',moulding(K.P.SILL,o.w+.5),mul(m4,M4(0,o.yb-.12,0)));
   if(o.kind==='sacada'){const sw=o.big?2.3:o.w+.55;put('stone',bevelBox(sw,.13,.62,.02),mul(m4,M4(0,o.yb-.06,.31)));
     for(const s of[-1,1])put('stone',corbelG,mul(m4,M4(s*(sw/2-.22),o.yb-.13,0)));
     put('iron',railing(Math.round((sw-.2)*20)/20),mul(m4,M4(0,o.yb,.55)));for(const s of[-1,1])put('iron',boxG(.03,.03,.55),mul(m4,M4(s*(sw-.2)/2,o.yb+.95,.28)));}
   if(o.kind==='sacada'||o.kind==='janela'||o.kind==='porta'||o.lintel)put('stone',moulding(K.P.LINTEL,o.w+.75),mul(m4,M4(0,o.yt+.24+(o.rise>0?o.rise*.5:0),0)));
   if(!o.noKey)put('stone',bevelBox(.2,.3,.16,.02),mul(m4,M4(0,o.yt+.08,.06)));
   if(o.kind==='grade')put('iron',grille(o),m4);
   if(o.kind==='porta')K.openDoor(o,m4,2.6,false,o.woodKey||'wood');
   else if(o.kind==='seteira'){put('dark',boxG(o.w,o.yt-o.yb,.1),mul(m4,M4(0,(o.yt+o.yb)/2,-.35)));}
   else if(o.kind==='sineira'){/* aberta: sem vidro */}
   else{put('wood',woodRing(o,.24),m4);put('glass',glassFor(o,.24,o.kind==='sacada'?(R()<.25?1:0):(R()<.2?3:2)),m4);}}};
 // ---------- corridas de moldura, cunhais ----------
 K.run=(m4,len,prof,y,gaps=[])=>{let x=-len/2;for(const [a,b] of gaps.slice().sort((p,q)=>p[0]-q[0])){if(a>x)put('stone',moulding(prof,+(a-x).toFixed(3)),mul(m4,M4((x+a)/2,y,0)));x=b;}
   if(x<len/2)put('stone',moulding(prof,+(len/2-x).toFixed(3)),mul(m4,M4((x+len/2)/2,y,0)));};
 K.quoins=(m4,y0,y1,blk=.42)=>{let y=y0,i=0;while(y<y1-.3){const h=Math.min(blk+((i*7)%3)*.04,y1-y),long=i%2===0;const a=long?.74:.48,b=long?.48:.74;
   put('stone',bevelBox(a,h-.03,.46,.025),mul(m4,M4(-a/2+.06,y+h/2,-.23+.06)));put('stone',bevelBox(.46,h-.03,b,.025),mul(m4,M4(-.23+.06,y+h/2,-b/2+.06)));y+=h;i++;}};
 // ---------- telhados: quatro águas, duas águas e pirâmide, com telhas de capa e canal ----------
 const tiles={capa:[],canal:[],crest:[]};
 const plane=(eaveA,eaveB,ridgeA,ridgeB,skip)=>{// quadrilátero inclinado: beiral A→B, cumeeira ridgeA→ridgeB (podem coincidir: triângulo)
   const V=THREE.Vector3,A=new V(...eaveA),B=new V(...eaveB),RA=new V(...ridgeA),RB=new V(...ridgeB);
   const mid0=A.clone().add(B).multiplyScalar(.5),mid1=RA.clone().add(RB).multiplyScalar(.5),up=mid1.clone().sub(mid0),Ls=up.length();up.normalize();
   const along=B.clone().sub(A).normalize(),pitch=Math.asin(Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,up.y))),rot=Math.atan2(-up.x,-up.z);
   for(let sl=.22;sl<Ls-.12;sl+=.36){const t=sl/Ls,a=A.clone().lerp(RA,t),b=B.clone().lerp(RB,t),len=a.distanceTo(b);
     for(let u=.16;u<=len-.16;u+=.26){const p=a.clone().addScaledVector(along,u);if(skip&&skip(p.x,p.z))continue;const j=(R()-.5)*.025;
       tiles.capa.push([p.x,p.y+.08,p.z,rot,pitch,j,t]);if(u+.13<=len-.1){const q=p.clone().addScaledVector(along,.13);tiles.canal.push([q.x,q.y+.1,q.z,rot,pitch,j,t]);}}}
   const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry(),v=[];const tri=(a,b,c)=>{for(const q of[a,b,c])v.push(q.x,q.y-.06,q.z);};tri(A,B,RB);if(RA.distanceTo(RB)>.01)tri(A,RB,RA);
   g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(v,3));g.computeVertexNormals();if(g.attributes.normal.getY(0)<0){const n=g.attributes.normal;for(let i=0;i<n.count;i++)n.setXYZ(i,-n.getX(i),-n.getY(i),-n.getZ(i));const p=g.attributes.position;for(let i=0;i<p.count;i+=3){const x=p.getX(i+1),y=p.getY(i+1),z=p.getZ(i+1);p.setXYZ(i+1,p.getX(i+2),p.getY(i+2),p.getZ(i+2));p.setXYZ(i+2,x,y,z);}}
   g.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(v.length/3*2),2));put('under',g);};
 const crest=K.crest=(a,b)=>{const L=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1],b[2]-a[2]),n=Math.ceil(L/.4);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const t=(i+.5)/n;tiles.crest.push([a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*t,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*t+.1,a[2]+(b[2]-a[2])*t,Math.atan2(b[0]-a[0],b[2]-a[2]),-Math.asin((b[1]-a[1])/L)]);}};
 K.roofHip=(cx,cz,hw,hd,y0,rise,skip)=>{const run=Math.min(hw,hd),rh=hw-run,A=[cx-hw,y0,cz+hd],B=[cx+hw,y0,cz+hd],C=[cx+hw,y0,cz-hd],D=[cx-hw,y0,cz-hd],R1=[cx-rh,y0+rise,cz],R2=[cx+rh,y0+rise,cz];
   plane(A,B,R1,R2,skip);plane(C,D,R2,R1,skip);plane(B,C,R2,R2,skip);plane(D,A,R1,R1,skip);if(rh>0)crest(R1,R2);for(const [c,r] of[[A,R1],[B,R2],[C,R2],[D,R1]])crest(c,r);};
 K.roofGable=(cx,cz,hw,hl,y0,rise,skip)=>{// cumeeira ao longo de z
   const A=[cx+hw,y0,cz+hl],B=[cx+hw,y0,cz-hl],C=[cx-hw,y0,cz-hl],D=[cx-hw,y0,cz+hl],R1=[cx,y0+rise,cz+hl],R2=[cx,y0+rise,cz-hl];
   plane(B,A,R2,R1,skip);plane(D,C,R1,R2,skip);crest(R1,R2);};
 // ---------- montagem final ----------
 const tileG=(r0,r1,len,up)=>{const g=new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r1,r0,len,6,1,true,-Math.PI/2,Math.PI);g.rotateX(Math.PI/2);if(up)g.rotateZ(Math.PI);return g;};
 const terr=(c,t)=>{const r=R();c.setHSL(.03+R()*.035,.5+R()*.18,.36+R()*.12-(t[6]||0)*.04);if(r<.06)c.lerp(new THREE.Color(.33,.36,.22),.55);if(r>.93)c.multiplyScalar(.7);if(R()<.08)c.lerp(new THREE.Color(.62,.55,.48),.35);};
 const inst=(list,geo,fn)=>{if(!list.length)return;const im=new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo,SH.tile,list.length),m=new THREE.Matrix4(),q=new THREE.Quaternion(),e=new THREE.Euler(),c=new THREE.Color();
   list.forEach((t,i)=>{e.set(t[4],t[3],0,'YXZ');q.setFromEuler(e);m.compose(new THREE.Vector3(t[0],t[1],t[2]),q,new THREE.Vector3(1+(t[5]||0)*2,1,1));im.setMatrixAt(i,m);fn(c,t);im.setColorAt(i,c);});
   im.instanceColor.needsUpdate=true;im.receiveShadow=true;G.add(im);};
 K.paintWeather=()=>{const k=1024/ATL;
   for(const J of paintJobs){const [rx,ry,rw,rh]=J.rect,len=J.len,y0=J.y0,y1=J.y1;const X=x=>(rx+(x+len/2)/len*rw)*k,Y=y=>(ry+(y1-y)/(y1-y0)*rh)*k,S=rw*k/len;

// ====================== V35 · Nau Príncipe Real (nau de 80 peças, Lisboa 1771) ======================
// Capitânia da esquadra que trouxe D. João. Duas cobertas de artilharia, casco forrado de cobre, popa com varandas,
// três mastros com mastaréus, velas de lona, cordame, âncoras e amarras. Fundeada: as velas grandes estão ferradas
// nas vergas e as de gávea estão soltas, como se fazia para secar o pano no porto.
const V35={ok:false,err:[]};
function NAU35(opt={}){
 const R=(()=>{let s=opt.seed||1771;return()=>{s=(s*1103515245+12345)&0x7fffffff;return s/0x7fffffff;};})();
 const root=new THREE.Group(),core=new THREE.Group(),detail=new THREE.Group();root.add(core,detail);root.name='nau35';
 const V3=(x,y,z)=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z),M4=(x=0,y=0,z=0,rx=0,ry=0,rz=0,sx=1,sy=1,sz=1)=>new THREE.Matrix4().compose(V3(x,y,z),new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(rx,ry,rz)),V3(sx,sy,sz));

 const ss=(a,b,x)=>{const t=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(x-a)/(b-a)));return t*t*(3-2*t);};

 {const pos=[],uv=[],idx=[];for(let j=0;j<=NT;j++){const t=j/NT,a=hullPt(0,t,1),b=hullPt(0,t,-1);pos.push(a.x,a.y,a.z,b.x,b.y,b.z);uv.push(0,HV(a.y),.02,HV(b.y));}

// ====================== V38 · Litoral norte: Prainha, Valonguinho e Valongo ======================
// O mapa de 1808–1821 mostra a costa subindo do Paço até o Morro de São Bento e, dali, virando para oeste:
// Prainha, Valonguinho e Valongo ficam na margem NORTE, ao pé dos morros. No jogo, x = leste e z = sul,
// então "norte" é z negativo. A linha abaixo é a borda de terra (alto da praia ou crista do cais), em unidades do jogo.
// Cenário condensado: não é restituição métrica.
// tipo: 'r' = pedra/encosta, 'b' = praia, 'c' = cais de cantaria (muro vertical)
const NSH=[[70,-100.5,'r'],[48,-100.5,'r'],[40,-101.5,'r'],[35,-103.2,'b'],[28,-106.2,'b'],[21,-107.4,'c'],[11.5,-107.4,'r'],[6,-106.2,'r'],
 [-2,-106.6,'b'],[-10,-108.2,'b'],[-20,-110.2,'b'],[-29,-112.2,'b'],[-33,-113.5,'c'],[-71,-113.5,'b'],[-78,-112,'b'],[-90,-108.6,'b'],[-102,-106.2,'b'],[-130,-104.2,'b'],[-200,-104,'b']];
const northZ=x=>{if(x>=NSH[0][0])return NSH[0][1];for(let i=1;i<NSH.length;i++){const a=NSH[i-1],b=NSH[i];if(x>=b[0]){const t=(x-b[0])/(a[0]-b[0]);return b[1]+(a[1]-b[1])*t;}}return NSH[NSH.length-1][1];};
const northType=x=>{if(x>=NSH[0][0])return NSH[0][2];for(let i=1;i<NSH.length;i++)if(x>=NSH[i][0])return NSH[i-1][2];return 'b';};
// distância aproximada ao mar (positiva = mar). O litoral leste continua sendo coastX(z).
const seaD=(x,z)=>Math.max(x-coastX(z),northZ(x)-z);
const isSea38=(x,z)=>seaD(x,z)>0;
// GLSL do mesmo contorno, para a cor da água
const NSH_GLSL=(()=>{let s='float nZ38(float x){';for(let i=1;i<NSH.length;i++){const a=NSH[i-1],b=NSH[i];s+=`if(x>=${b[0].toFixed(1)})return mix(${b[1].toFixed(2)},${a[1].toFixed(2)},clamp((x-(${b[0].toFixed(1)}))/${(a[0]-b[0]).toFixed(1)},0.0,1.0));`;}return s+'return -104.0;}';})();

 const pathLen=pts=>{let L=0;for(let i=0;i<pts.length-1;i++)L+=Math.hypot(pts[i+1][0]-pts[i][0],pts[i+1][1]-pts[i][1]);return L;};

   else if(c<21){const k=(c-15)/6,p=along(PB,k*pathLen(PB));porter.g.position.set(p.x,gy(p.x,p.z),p.z);porter.g.rotation.y=p.yaw;speed=1.1;bale.position.set(p.x,porter.g.position.y+1.62,p.z);armX=-2.6;}
   else{const k=Math.min(1,(c-21)/6);const back=[[38.7,-19.2],[37.4,-23.2],[38.0,-26.9]],p=along(back,k*pathLen(back));porter.g.position.set(p.x,gy(p.x,p.z),p.z);porter.g.rotation.y=p.yaw;speed=k<1?1.0:0;bale.position.set(38.4,gy(38.4,-18.5),-18.5);}

   fiscal.g.rotation.y=.6+Math.sin(t*.3)*.25;

   pullA.anim(dt,load?0:1.0);pushB.anim(dt,load?0:1.0);pullA.arms.forEach(a=>a.rotation.x=load?-.3:.25);pushB.arms.forEach(a=>a.rotation.x=load?-1.6+Math.sin(t*3)*.4:-1.4);

 V37.ok=true;V37.ms=performance.now()-t0;}catch(e){V37.err.push(e.message);console.warn('V37',e);}},60);

// ====================== V38 · Prainha, Valonguinho e Valongo na margem norte ======================
// Parte A (síncrona): novo relevo do litoral norte, limpeza do Valongo antigo (que ficava na costa leste) e
// remapeamento explícito de missões, pessoas, objetos e lugares. Parte B (adiada): arquitetura, cais, barcos e rotinas.
const V38={ok:false,err:[],ms:0,moved:[],removed:0,actors:[],zone:null};
try{
 const H0=H;
 const plat0=(x,z)=>{const cx=coastX(z),b0=x<cx?.3:.3-Math.min(5,(x-cx)*.6),n0=.25*Math.sin(x*.05)*Math.cos(z*.07)*(x<cx-4?1:0);return H0(x,z)-b0-n0;};
 const sstep=(a,b,v)=>{const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(v-a)/(b-a)));return t*t*(3-2*t);};
 // degraus, rampas e trapiches entram no relevo: é assim que o Tonico sobe e desce (a altura vem de H)
 const FEATS=[];V38.FEATS=FEATS;
 const feat=(o)=>{FEATS.push(o);return o;};
 // escadas e rampas: x0..x1, z0..z1 (z0 = lado de terra, z1 = lado do mar), do topo (crista) até 'bot'
 V38.addFeat=feat;
 const featH=(x,z)=>{for(let i=FEATS.length-1;i>=0;i--){const f=FEATS[i];if(x<f.x0||x>f.x1||z>f.zA||z<f.zB)continue;
   if(f.kind==='deck')return f.y;
   const t=f.axis==='x'?(f.dir>0?(x-f.x0)/(f.x1-f.x0):(f.x1-x)/(f.x1-f.x0)):(f.zA-z)/(f.zA-f.zB);
   return f.top+(f.bot-f.top)*Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));}return null;};

 {const L=(V23.links||[]).find(l=>l.p&&l.p.id==='valongoArmazens');if(L){L.x=CV1.cx+1.0;L.z=VZ-.55;L.nx=0;L.nz=-1;L.armed=true;V38.link=L;}}

// ---------- V38 · Parte D: objetos de uso, barcos e pessoas com rotinas (Prainha, Valonguinho, Valongo) ----------
// Ninguém é identificado como livre, liberto ou escravizado pela cor, pela roupa ou pelos pés descalços.
// No Valongo, as rotinas mostram controle e espera sob coerção, sem violência gráfica, sem nudez e sem qualquer
// ação do jogador de escolher, comprar, vender ou dar preço a pessoas.
V38.partD=(C)=>{const {gy,SEC,MAT,M4,V3,mStd,R,cvTex,T}=C;const t0=performance.now();
 const parts={prainha:{},valonguinho:{},valongo:{}};
 const put=(sec,key,geo,m)=>{(parts[sec][key]=parts[sec][key]||[]).push([geo,m||new THREE.Matrix4()]);};
 const PM={wood:MAT.wood,woodD:MAT.woodD,rope:MAT.rope,awning:MAT.awning,mat:MAT.mat,iron:MAT.iron,flag:MAT.flag,
   basket:mStd({color:0xb08a52,roughness:1}),fish:mStd({color:0xbfc3c0,roughness:.45,metalness:.15}),fruitY:mStd({color:0xd9a23a}),fruitG:mStd({color:0x6f8f3e}),fruitR:mStd({color:0xa9472f}),
   cloth:mStd({color:0x8a7a62,roughness:1,side:THREE.DoubleSide}),clay:mStd({color:0x9c5e3c,roughness:.85}),sack:mStd({color:0xb39c74,roughness:1}),ledger:mStd({color:0xe9e0c8}),leather:mStd({color:0x4a2e1c})};
 // ----- geometrias reaproveitadas -----
 const basketG=new THREE.LatheGeometry([[0,0],[.2,0],[.27,.06],[.3,.22],[.31,.26],[.29,.27]].map(([a,b])=>new THREE.Vector2(a,b)),12);
 const fishG=(()=>{const g=new THREE.SphereGeometry(.07,8,6);g.scale(2.6,.6,1);return g;})();
 const fruitG=new THREE.SphereGeometry(.075,8,6);
 const barrelG=new THREE.LatheGeometry([[0,0],[.3,0],[.36,.3],[.38,.5],[.36,.7],[.3,.98],[0,.98]].map(([a,b])=>new THREE.Vector2(a,b)),12);
 const hoopG=new THREE.TorusGeometry(.37,.02,4,16);hoopG.rotateX(Math.PI/2);
 const coilG=new THREE.TorusGeometry(.26,.07,6,14);coilG.rotateX(Math.PI/2);
 const sackG=(()=>{const g=new THREE.SphereGeometry(.3,10,8);const p=g.attributes.position;for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){const y=p.getY(i);p.setXYZ(i,p.getX(i)*(1-.25*Math.max(0,y/.3)),Math.max(-.2,y*1.25)+.2,p.getZ(i)*(1-.25*Math.max(0,y/.3)));}g.computeVertexNormals();return g;})();
 const jarG=new THREE.LatheGeometry([[0,0],[.16,0],[.26,.18],[.28,.36],[.2,.6],[.12,.68],[.14,.74],[0,.74]].map(([a,b])=>new THREE.Vector2(a,b)),12);
 const box=(w,h,d)=>new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,d);
 const at=(x,z,dy=0,ry=0,s=1)=>M4(x,gy(x,z)+dy,z,0,ry,0,s,s,s);
 // ----- peças compostas -----
 const barrel=(sec,x,z,ry=0,s=1)=>{put(sec,'wood',barrelG,at(x,z,0,ry,s));for(const y of[.12,.86])put(sec,'iron',hoopG,at(x,z,y*s,ry,s));};
 const crate=(sec,x,z,ry=0,w=.9,h=.55,d=.6,dy=0)=>{const g=box(w,h,d);g.translate(0,h/2,0);put(sec,'wood',g,at(x,z,dy,ry));const b=box(w+.02,.06,.06);for(const s of[-1,1]){const q=b.clone();q.translate(0,h-.06,s*(d/2-.02));put(sec,'woodD',q,at(x,z,dy,ry));}};
 const sack=(sec,x,z,ry=0,dy=0)=>put(sec,'sack',sackG,M4(x,gy(x,z)+dy,z,0,ry,0,1,.85,1.15));
 const coil=(sec,x,z)=>{for(let i=0;i<3;i++)put(sec,'rope',coilG,at(x,z,.07+i*.11,0,1-i*.12));};
 const basketF=(sec,x,z,kind='fish',dy=0)=>{put(sec,'basket',basketG,at(x,z,dy));const y=gy(x,z)+dy+.25;for(let i=0;i<(kind==='fish'?6:7);i++){const a=i*2.3,r=.1+(i%3)*.05;
     if(kind==='fish')put(sec,'fish',fishG,M4(x+Math.cos(a)*r,y+(i%2)*.04,z+Math.sin(a)*r,0,a,(i%2)*.4));else put(sec,['fruitY','fruitG','fruitR'][i%3],fruitG,M4(x+Math.cos(a)*r,y+(i%2)*.05,z+Math.sin(a)*r));}};
 const stall=(sec,x,z,ry,w=2.4,d=1.6)=>{const base=M4(x,gy(x,z),z,0,ry,0);const L=(g,m)=>put(sec,m,g,new THREE.Matrix4().multiplyMatrices(base,M4(...g.__p)));
   for(const [px,pz,h] of[[-w/2,-d/2,2.3],[w/2,-d/2,2.3],[-w/2,d/2,1.9],[w/2,d/2,1.9]]){const g=box(.09,h,.09);g.__p=[px,h/2,pz];L(g,'woodD');}
   const aw=new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w+.5,d+.6,6,3);const ap=aw.attributes.position;for(let i=0;i<ap.count;i++)ap.setZ(i,Math.sin((ap.getX(i)/(w+.5)+.5)*Math.PI*3)*.04);aw.rotateX(-Math.PI/2+.26);aw.__p=[0,2.12,0];L(aw,'awning');
   const tb=box(w-.1,.07,d*.62);tb.__p=[0,.82,-.12];L(tb,'wood');for(const s of[-1,1])for(const t of[-1,1]){const lg=box(.06,.8,.06);lg.__p=[s*(w/2-.2),.4,-.12+t*d*.25];L(lg,'woodD');}};
 const netFrame=(sec,x,z,ry=0)=>{const base=M4(x,gy(x,z),z,0,ry,0);for(const s of[-1.4,1.4]){const p=box(.08,1.9,.08);p.translate(s,.95,0);put(sec,'woodD',p,base);}const bar=box(3,.06,.06);bar.translate(0,1.86,0);put(sec,'woodD',bar,base);
   const n=new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2.7,1.5,8,4);const np=n.attributes.position;for(let i=0;i<np.count;i++)np.setZ(i,Math.sin(np.getX(i)*1.6)*.08+(np.getY(i)<-.5?.12:0));n.translate(0,1.1,0);put(sec,'net',n,base);};
 PM.net=MAT.net;
 // =============== PRAINHA ===============
 stall('prainha',19.2,-104.2,.08);stall('prainha',22.5,-104.7,-.05,2.2,1.5);
 for(const [x,z,k] of[[18.6,-104.15,'fruit'],[19.7,-104.2,'fruit'],[22.0,-104.8,'fish'],[23.0,-104.7,'fish']])basketF('prainha',x,z,k,.85);
 for(const [x,z,k] of[[27.4,-105.4,'fish'],[28.1,-105.0,'fish'],[17.6,-103.2,'fruit'],[24.0,-103.6,'fruit']])basketF('prainha',x,z,k);
 netFrame('prainha',37.6,-101.9,.2);
 for(const [x,z,r] of[[22.9,-100.0,.2],[23.8,-100.2,-.3],[19.0,-99.8,.1]])barrel('prainha',x,z,r);
 crate('prainha',24.6,-100.1,.1);crate('prainha',24.7,-100.1,-.05,.9,.55,.6,.56);sack('prainha',20.0,-100.2,.4);sack('prainha',20.6,-100.4,1.2);
 for(const [x,z] of[[25.6,-107.0],[26.6,-107.3],[25.9,-107.9]])sack('prainha',x,z,R()*3,.62);crate('prainha',26.4,-109.0,.1,.9,.55,.6,.62);coil('prainha',25.4,-110.4);
 coil('prainha',33.1,-104.4);coil('prainha',12.8,-105.6);barrel('prainha',13.8,-105.8,.3,.9);
 // =============== VALONGUINHO ===============
 netFrame('valonguinho',-24.6,-109.6,-.18);coil('valonguinho',-12.6,-107.8);basketF('valonguinho',-13.4,-107.2,'fish');basketF('valonguinho',-22.8,-106.0,'fruit');
 {const base=M4(-3.6,gy(-3.6,-102.2),-102.2,0,.2,0);const b=box(.9,.5,.9);b.translate(0,.25,0);put('valonguinho','flag',b,base);const p=box(.14,2.6,.14);p.translate(0,1.8,0);put('valonguinho','woodD',p,base);const a=box(1.1,.13,.13);a.translate(0,2.6,0);put('valonguinho','woodD',a,base);colliders.push({x:-3.6,z:-102.2,r:.55});}
 // banco e banquinho do barbeiro (diante da casa amarela)
 {const b=box(.42,.42,.42);b.translate(0,.21,0);put('valonguinho','wood',b,at(-13.0,-104.3));colliders.push({x:-13.0,z:-104.3,r:.4});}
 // =============== VALONGO ===============
 // mesa do registro, banco do guarda, esteiras, barris, talhas d'água
 const TX=-45.8,TZ=-109.2;{const tb=box(1.5,.07,.9);tb.translate(0,.84,0);put('valongo','wood',tb,at(TX,TZ));for(const s of[-1,1])for(const t of[-1,1]){const lg=box(.07,.82,.07);lg.translate(s*.65,.41,t*.36);put('valongo','woodD',lg,at(TX,TZ));}
   const bk=box(.5,.05,.36);bk.translate(.1,.9,0);put('valongo','ledger',bk,at(TX,TZ));const st=box(.45,.45,.45);st.translate(0,.22,0);put('valongo','wood',st,at(TX,TZ+.9));colliders.push({x:TX,z:TZ,hw:.8,hd:.5});}
 for(const [x,z,w] of[[-50.6,-111.9,2.6],[-54.6,-112.1,2.4],[-56.0,-110.4,1.8]]){const m=new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w,1.2);m.rotateX(-Math.PI/2);put('valongo','mat',m,at(x,z,.03,.1*R()));}
 for(const [x,z,r] of[[-62.6,-106.0,.2],[-63.4,-106.3,.9],[-72.0,-106.0,.4],[-35.0,-106.0,.1]])barrel('valongo',x,z,r);
 for(const [x,z] of[[-57.0,-105.9],[-71.0,-106.1]])put('valongo','clay',jarG,at(x,z));
 for(const [x,z,r] of[[-60.6,-106.2,.3],[-61.2,-106.6,1.4],[-60.9,-106.2,.6]])sack('valongo',x,z,r);
 coil('valongo',-63.2,-112.3);coil('valongo',-38.6,-112.4);
 // guarita de madeira, como nas vistas do cais da época (posto de vigia)
 {const base=at(-39.6,-110.9);const w=box(1.1,2.3,1.1);w.translate(0,1.15,0);put('valongo','woodD',w,base);const rf=new THREE.ConeGeometry(.95,.7,4);rf.rotateY(Math.PI/4);rf.translate(0,2.65,0);put('valongo','clay',rf,base);
   const dark=box(.7,1.7,.05);dark.translate(0,.95,-.56);put('valongo','iron',dark,base);colliders.push({x:-39.6,z:-110.9,r:.75});}
 // marco da memória (região do Cemitério dos Pretos Novos, na Gamboa): cruz simples de madeira e pedras, sem réplica
 {const base=at(-101.6,-100.2,0,.4);const b=box(1.4,.35,1.0);b.translate(0,.17,0);put('valongo','flag',b,base);const p=box(.16,2.2,.16);p.translate(0,1.4,0);put('valongo','woodD',p,base);const a=box(1.0,.14,.14);a.translate(0,2.0,0);put('valongo','woodD',a,base);
   for(let i=0;i<9;i++){const s=new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(.18+R()*.12,0);put('valongo','flag',s,at(-101.6+Math.cos(i*.7)*1.6,-100.2+Math.sin(i*.7)*1.1,.05));}colliders.push({x:-101.6,z:-100.2,r:.8});}
 // ----- junta tudo por material -----
 for(const sec in parts)for(const key in parts[sec]){const geo=mergeGeos(parts[sec][key]);geo.computeBoundingSphere();const m=new THREE.Mesh(geo,PM[key]||MAT[key]);m.castShadow=!['awning','net','mat'].includes(key)||key==='awning';m.receiveShadow=true;SEC[sec].add(m);}
 // colisões das barracas e pilhas
 for(const [x,z,r] of[[19.2,-104.2,1.0],[22.5,-104.7,.95],[23.3,-100.1,.7],[24.6,-100.1,.55],[19.0,-99.8,.4],[20.3,-100.3,.5],[-62.9,-106.1,.65],[-60.9,-106.3,.6],[-72.0,-106.0,.4],[-35.0,-106.0,.4],[37.6,-101.9,.3],[-24.6,-109.6,.3]])colliders.push({x,z,r});
 // =============== BARCOS ===============
 const boats=[];const boat=(sec,type,x,z,ry,o={})=>{const b=BOAT36(type,o);b.position.set(x,-.88,z);b.rotation.y=ry;SEC[sec].add(b);boats.push(b);return b;};
 boat('prainha','canoa',31.6,-106.2,1.25,{seed:3}).position.y=-.32;boat('prainha','canoa',36.6,-104.4,1.9,{seed:5}).position.y=-.3;
 boat('prainha','canoa',33.4,-111.8,0,{seed:7});boat('prainha','canoa',16.1,-111.6,.1,{seed:9});
 // saveiro fundeado: casco de baleeira com mastro e vela latina
 {const s=boat('prainha','baleeira',28.5,-119.5,.7,{seed:11});const mast=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.07,.09,6.2,7),MAT.woodD);mast.position.set(0,3.2,1.2);s.add(mast);
   const sg=new THREE.BufferGeometry();sg.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute([0,.9,1.25, 0,6.0,.9, 0,1.2,-3.0, 0,6.0,.9, 0,1.2,-3.0, 0,4.4,-3.9],3));sg.computeVertexNormals();
   const sail=new THREE.Mesh(sg,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xe6dcc4,roughness:.95,side:THREE.DoubleSide}));sail.position.x=.05;s.add(sail);}
 boat('valonguinho','canoa',-14.6,-109.0,1.4,{seed:13}).position.y=-.35;boat('valonguinho','canoa',-19.6,-110.3,1.6,{seed:15}).position.y=-.4;
 boat('valongo','canoa',-59.5,-119.4,0,{seed:17});boat('valongo','canoa',-35.0,-117.6,.15,{seed:19});
 // o navio negreiro sai da costa leste e fica fundeado diante do Valongo
 {const S=SHIPS.find(q=>Math.abs(q.g.position.x-112)<.8&&Math.abs(q.g.position.z+108)<.8);if(S){S.g.position.x=-44;S.g.position.z=-150;S.g.rotation.y=1.45;V38.negreiro=S;}}
 V38.boats=boats;
 V38.msD=performance.now()-t0;
 if(typeof V38.partE==='function')V38.partE(C);
};

// ---------- V38 · Parte E: pessoas e rotinas ----------
V38.partE=(C)=>{const {gy,SEC}=C;const t0=performance.now();
 const lib=V32&&V32.lib;const PG={};for(const k in SEC){PG[k]=new THREE.Group();PG[k].name='pessoas38_'+k;PG[k].userData.c=SEC[k].userData.c;SEC[k].add(PG[k]);}V38.PG=PG;
 const mk=(sec,id,o,x,z,ry)=>{const f=lib?lib.create(id,Object.assign({child:0},o)):makeFigure(o);f.g.position.set(x,gy(x,z),z);f.g.rotation.y=ry;PG[sec].add(f.g);V38.actors.push(f);f.sec=sec;return f;};
 const sit=(f,seatH)=>{for(const l of f.legs){l.rotation.x=-1.45;if(l.userData.knee)l.userData.knee.rotation.x=1.45;}f.g.position.y+=seatH-.86;f.sat=1;};
 const ground=(f)=>{for(const l of f.legs){l.rotation.x=-1.5;if(l.userData.knee)l.userData.knee.rotation.x=2.2;}};  // sentado no chão, joelhos dobrados
 const unsit=f=>{for(const l of f.legs){l.rotation.x=0;if(l.userData.knee)l.userData.knee.rotation.x=0;}f.sat=0;};
 const len=P=>{let L=0;for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++)L+=Math.hypot(P[i][0]-P[i-1][0],P[i][1]-P[i-1][1]);return L;};
 const along=(P,d)=>{for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++){const a=P[i-1],b=P[i],L=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]);if(d<=L||i===P.length-1){const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,d/L));return {x:a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*t,z:a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*t,yaw:Math.atan2(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])};}d-=L;}return {x:P[0][0],z:P[0][1],yaw:0};};
 const place=(f,p)=>{f.g.position.set(p.x,gy(p.x,p.z),p.z);f.g.rotation.y=p.yaw;};
 const SKIN=[0x3e2618,0x4a2e1e,0x5c3a24,0x6c4630,0x7a5238,0x8a5e40,0x996846,0xb98763,0xd1a17d,0xe0b18c];
 const CL=[0xc7b694,0xb9a584,0xd8cfb8,0x9a8466,0x7d6a52,0xe3d8c0,0x8c7458,0xa69172,0x6e6050];
 const pick=(a,i)=>a[i%a.length];
 const routines=[];V38.routines=routines;
 // ================= PRAINHA =================
 // pescadores consertando a rede (sentados na areia)
 const fA=mk('prainha','jacinto',{prop:null,skin:SKIN[2],shirt:CL[0],pants:CL[4],hat:'straw'},34.3,-105.0,-2.6);ground(fA);fA.g.position.y-=.62;
 const fB=mk('prainha','domingos',{prop:null,skin:SKIN[5],shirt:CL[5],pants:CL[8],vest:undefined,hat:'straw'},35.6,-104.6,-2.0);ground(fB);fB.g.position.y-=.62;
 routines.push((t,dt)=>{fA.arms[0].rotation.x=-1.0+Math.sin(t*2.1)*.25;fA.arms[1].rotation.x=-.9+Math.sin(t*2.1+1.3)*.3;fB.arms[1].rotation.x=-1.1+Math.sin(t*1.7+.5)*.3;fB.arms[0].rotation.x=-.7;});
 // rede estendida entre os dois (plano curvo)
 {const n=new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.6,1.0,6,4);const p=n.attributes.position;for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++)p.setZ(i,Math.sin(p.getX(i)*2)*.06);n.rotateX(-Math.PI/2+.25);const m=new THREE.Mesh(n,V38.MAT.net);m.position.set(34.95,gy(34.95,-104.8)+.35,-104.8);m.rotation.y=-.4;SEC.prainha.add(m);}
 // quitandeira sentada na barraca e uma freguesa conversando
 const vend=mk('prainha','luzia',{prop:null},19.2,-103.55,Math.PI);sit(vend,.42);
 const cust=mk('prainha','rosa',{},19.6,-105.6,-.2);
 routines.push((t,dt)=>{vend.arms[0].rotation.x=-.5+Math.sin(t*1.4)*.35;cust.anim(dt,0);cust.arms[1].rotation.x=-.4+Math.max(0,Math.sin(t*.9))*-.6;cust.g.rotation.y=-.2+Math.sin(t*.3)*.15;});
 // vendedor de peixe em pé
 const pes=mk('prainha','jacinto',{prop:null,skin:SKIN[1],shirt:CL[2],pants:CL[6],hat:'round'},22.6,-103.8,Math.PI);
 routines.push((t,dt)=>{pes.anim(dt,0);pes.arms[0].rotation.x=-.3+Math.sin(t*1.1)*.2;});
 // carregador: do trapiche coberto até a porta do armazém, com saca na cabeça
 const porter=mk('prainha','jacinto',{skin:SKIN[0],shirt:CL[1],pants:CL[4]},25.8,-111,0);
 const PP=[[26.1,-112.2],[26.1,-106.0],[24.6,-103.4],[22.8,-101.4],[22.6,-100.3]];const PL=len(PP);
 routines.push((t,dt)=>{const c=(t+7)%46;let sp=0;if(c<16){place(porter,along(PP,c/16*PL));sp=1.1;}else if(c<20){place(porter,along(PP,PL));}else if(c<36){const p=along(PP,PL-(c-20)/16*PL);p.yaw+=Math.PI;place(porter,p);sp=1.1;}else place(porter,{...along(PP,0),yaw:Math.PI});porter.anim(dt,sp);});
 // canoa a remo entre o trapiche e o saveiro
 const cano=BOAT36('canoa',{rowers:1,seed:21});SEC.prainha.add(cano);
 const CP=[[33.4,-113.6],[31.2,-117.0],[29.8,-117.6],[31.0,-114.0],[33.4,-113.6]];const CPL=len(CP);
 routines.push((t,dt)=>{const c=(t%70)/70;const p=along(CP,c*CPL);cano.position.set(p.x,-.88+Math.sin(t*1.3)*.02,p.z);cano.rotation.y=p.yaw;cano.userData.row(t,c%.5<.42?1:0);});
 // crianças correndo pela areia
 const k1=mk('prainha','tonico',{skin:SKIN[4],hat:undefined,shirt:CL[5],pants:CL[4],vest:undefined},30,-104.5,0),k2=mk('prainha','irma_tonico',{skin:SKIN[6]},30,-104.5,0);
 const KP=[[28.8,-104.8],[33.4,-103.9],[37.2,-102.8],[33.6,-104.6],[29.6,-105.4],[28.8,-104.8]];const KPL=len(KP);
 routines.push((t,dt)=>{for(const [k,off,sp] of[[k1,0,2.4],[k2,2.2,2.2]]){const d=((t*sp+off)%KPL);place(k,along(KP,d));k.anim(dt,1.6);}});
 // ================= VALONGUINHO =================
 const barb=mk('valonguinho','pai_tonico',{},-12.6,-104.0,-1.9),cli=mk('valonguinho','artesao',{prop:null,apron:undefined,skin:SKIN[7],shirt:CL[5]},-13.0,-104.3,-1.6);sit(cli,.44);
 routines.push((t,dt)=>{barb.anim(dt,0);barb.arms[1].rotation.x=-1.6+Math.sin(t*3.2)*.15;barb.arms[0].rotation.x=-1.1;cli.arms.forEach(a=>a.rotation.x=-.25);});

 const drape=(pts,w,mat,yOff=.05,step=.7,vScale=.5)=>{const Q=[];for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++){const a=pts[i-1],b=pts[i],L=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]),n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(L/step));for(let j=(i===1?0:1);j<=n;j++)Q.push([a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*j/n,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*j/n]);}

   if(sp.hair!=='wrap'){const cap=hg('cap',()=>{const g=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,30,18,0,Math.PI*2,0,Math.PI*.52),p=g.attributes.position;for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){const x=p.getX(i),y=p.getY(i),z=p.getZ(i);const n=1+.05*Math.abs(Math.sin(x*29+y*7)*Math.sin(y*31)*Math.sin(z*27+x*5));p.setXYZ(i,x*n,y*n,z*n);}g.computeVertexNormals();return g;});
     add(cap,hairC,0,.178,-.014,.103,.122,.113,.42,0,0);}
   if(sp.hair==='wrap'){const t=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:new THREE.Color(sp.top).multiplyScalar(.85).convertSRGBToLinear(),map:LINEN,roughness:.95});add(hg('wrap',()=>new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,24,14,0,Math.PI*2,0,Math.PI*.55)),t,0,.18,-.01,.114,.14,.122,-.15,0,0);}
   if(sp.hair==='straw'){const st=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:new THREE.Color(0xb9a16a).convertSRGBToLinear(),roughness:.95});add(hg('brim',()=>new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1,1,1,28)),st,0,.27,0,.22,.012,.22);add(hg('crown',()=>new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.75,1,1,24)),st,0,.31,0,.12,.09,.12);}
   // os ângulos da cabeça do pacote continuam valendo (idle/olhar)
 };
 V39.SCALE=1.08;
 // ---------------- cena do barbeiro (pacote "barbeiro-3d": RioBarbeiro + RioRugendas atualizada) ----------------
 const WOODT=(typeof TEX!=='undefined'&&TEX.wood)||null;
 V39.scene=()=>{const A=RioBarbeiro.create(THREE);const bar=A.bar,cli=A.cli;
   // tecidos com trama, pele com variação, cores em sRGB corretas (antes ficavam lavadas)
   V39.finish(bar,'barbeiro',{head:false,fingers:false});V39.finish(cli,'cliente',{head:false,fingers:false});
   // colete por fora da camisa (sem atravessar o tecido)
   bar.g.traverse(m=>{if(m.isMesh&&m.material.userData&&m.material.userData.hex===0x40566b){const p=m.geometry.attributes.position;for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){p.setX(i,p.getX(i)*1.13);p.setZ(i,p.getZ(i)*1.12+.006);}p.needsUpdate=true;m.geometry.computeBoundingSphere();}});
   // camisa um pouco mais justa por baixo do colete (o colete não deixa mais a camisa atravessar)
   bar.g.traverse(m=>{if(!m.isMesh||!m.material.userData||m.material.userData.hex!==0xcfc2a4)return;if(m.parent&&/braco|cotovelo|cabeca|coxa|joelho/.test(m.parent.name))return;
     const p=m.geometry.attributes.position;for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){const y=p.getY(i);if(y>.95&&y<1.47){const k=.93;p.setX(i,p.getX(i)*k);p.setZ(i,p.getZ(i)*k);}}p.needsUpdate=true;m.geometry.computeVertexNormals();});
   // olhos: menos saltados (globo achatado contra o rosto) e pálpebra superior de pele
   for(const who of[bar,cli]){let sk=null,eyes=[];who.head.traverse(m=>{if(!m.isMesh)return;const h=m.material.userData&&m.material.userData.hex;if(m.material.userData.kind==='skin')sk=m.material;if(h===0xd6c9ac||h===0x33241d)eyes.push(m);});
     let box=null;for(const m of eyes){const p=m.geometry.attributes.position;for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++)p.setZ(i,.084+(p.getZ(i)-.084)*.5);p.needsUpdate=true;m.geometry.computeBoundingBox();if(m.material.userData.hex===0xd6c9ac)box=m.geometry.boundingBox;}
     if(box&&sk){const cy=(box.min.y+box.max.y)/2,cz=box.max.z,hw=(box.max.x-box.min.x)/2;for(const s of[-1,1]){const lid=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,14,8,0,Math.PI*2,0,Math.PI*.5),sk);lid.scale.set(.03,.012,.013);lid.position.set(s*(hw-.03),cy+.003,cz-.006);lid.rotation.x=.35;who.head.add(lid);}}}
   // pano do freguês um pouco mais largo e caído (fica por fora dos joelhos)
   for(const k in A.objects){const o=A.objects[k];o.traverse(m=>{if(!m.isMesh)return;const c=m.material.clone();c.color.convertSRGBToLinear();const hex=m.material.color.getHex();
       if(WOODT&&[0x775133,0x48311f,0xa0774e].includes(hex)){c.map=WOODT;addUV(m.geometry,1.6);}if(hex===0xd4c7ad){c.map=LINEN;addUV(m.geometry,2);}m.material=c;m.castShadow=true;m.receiveShadow=true;});}
   A.objects.esmeril.position.set(-.15,0,-1.5);A.objects.esmeril.rotation.y=.4;
   let wheel=null;A.objects.esmeril.traverse(m=>{if(m.isMesh&&m.geometry.parameters&&m.geometry.parameters.radiusTop===.23)wheel=m;});
   if(wheel){const piv=new THREE.Group();piv.position.set(0,.66,0);A.objects.esmeril.add(piv);wheel.position.set(0,0,0);piv.add(wheel);A.wheel=piv;}   // esmeril atrás do freguês, fora das varas da cadeirinha
   // ---- reposiciona o barbeiro ao lado do rosto do freguês e resolve os braços por IK (mãos encostam de fato) ----
   A.g.updateMatrixWorld(true);
   const v=(x,y,z)=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);cli.pose('idle',0);cli.g.updateMatrixWorld(true);
   const HEADC=A.g.worldToLocal(new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixPosition(cli.head.matrixWorld));V39.HEADC=HEADC;   // base da cabeça do freguês sentado (coordenadas da cena)
   const bpx=HEADC.x+.46,bpz=HEADC.z+.3;bar.g.position.set(bpx,0,bpz);bar.g.rotation.y=Math.atan2(HEADC.x-bpx,HEADC.z-bpz)+.45;  // de frente para o rosto, um pouco de lado
   const L1=.30,L2=.285;
   const ik=(arm,T,pole)=>{const par=arm.parent;par.updateMatrixWorld(true);const inv=new THREE.Matrix4().copy(par.matrixWorld).invert();
     const S=new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixPosition(arm.matrixWorld).applyMatrix4(inv),t=T.clone().applyMatrix4(A.g.matrixWorld).applyMatrix4(inv),P=pole.clone();
     const sc=par.getWorldScale(new THREE.Vector3()).x/A.g.getWorldScale(new THREE.Vector3()).x;const l1=L1,l2=L2;let D=t.clone().sub(S);let d=Math.min(D.length(),(l1+l2)*.995);D.normalize();
     const a1=Math.acos(Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,(l1*l1+d*d-l2*l2)/(2*l1*d))));const side=P.clone().sub(D.clone().multiplyScalar(P.dot(D))).normalize();
     const u=D.clone().multiplyScalar(Math.cos(a1)).add(side.clone().multiplyScalar(Math.sin(a1))).normalize();   // direção do braço (ombro → cotovelo)
     const E=S.clone().add(u.clone().multiplyScalar(l1)),F=t.clone().sub(E).normalize();
     const y=u.clone().negate(),z=F.clone().sub(u.clone().multiplyScalar(F.dot(u))).normalize(),x=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(y,z);
     arm.quaternion.setFromRotationMatrix(new THREE.Matrix4().makeBasis(x,y,z));arm.userData.elbow.rotation.set(-Math.acos(Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,u.dot(F)))),0,0);};
   const body=bar.g.children[0];
   // ---- ciclo de trabalho (70 s): barbear · afiar a navalha no esmeril · pegar material na caixa · voltar a barbear ----
   const HOME=v(bpx,0,bpz),HOMEYAW=bar.g.rotation.y;A.g.updateMatrixWorld(true);
   const EP=A.objects.esmeril.position,ER=A.objects.esmeril.rotation.y,ESP=v(EP.x+Math.sin(ER)*.62,0,EP.z+Math.cos(ER)*.62);
   const toE=(x,y,z)=>v(EP.x+x*Math.cos(ER)+z*Math.sin(ER),y,EP.z-x*Math.sin(ER)+z*Math.cos(ER));
   const SUP=A.objects.suporte.position,BSP=v(SUP.x+.12,0,SUP.z+.62);
   const P1=[HOME,v(.66,0,-.42),ESP],P2=[HOME,v(.4,0,.98),BSP],P1r=P1.slice().reverse(),P2r=P2.slice().reverse();
   const plen=P=>{let L=0;for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++)L+=P[i].distanceTo(P[i-1]);return L;};
   const at=(P,d)=>{for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++){const L=P[i].distanceTo(P[i-1]);if(d<=L||i===P.length-1){const k=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,d/L));return {p:P[i-1].clone().lerp(P[i],k),yaw:Math.atan2(P[i].x-P[i-1].x,P[i].z-P[i-1].z)};}d-=L;}};
   const face=(a,b)=>{let d=b-a;d=Math.atan2(Math.sin(d),Math.cos(d));return d;};
   let curYaw=HOMEYAW;
   const walkTo=(P,u,t,dt)=>{const q=at(P,u*plen(P));bar.g.position.set(q.p.x,0,q.p.z);curYaw+=face(curYaw,q.yaw)*.25;bar.g.rotation.y=curYaw;bar.pose('walk',t);body.rotation.x=0;};
   const stand=(pos,yaw)=>{bar.g.position.set(pos.x,0,pos.z);curYaw+=face(curYaw,yaw)*.2;bar.g.rotation.y=curYaw;};
   A.anim=(dt,t)=>{cli.pose('idle',t);
     // freguês: cabeça levemente inclinada para trás; braços quietos por baixo do pano
     cli.head.rotation.set(-.22,-.15,-.12);cli.arms.forEach((a,i)=>{a.rotation.set(-.22,0,(i?-1:1)*.02);a.userData.elbow.rotation.x=-1.05;a.userData.elbow.visible=false;});
     const C=t%70;const hc=(x,y,z)=>HEADC.clone().add(v(x,y,z));
     const shave=(c)=>{stand(HOME,HOMEYAW);bar.pose('idle',t);body.rotation.x=.12;bar.head.rotation.set(.32,-.25,0);let raz;
       if(c<9){const k=(c*1.6)%1;raz=hc(.078,.095-.065*k,.085+.008*k);}else if(c<11){const k=Math.sin((c-9)/2*Math.PI);raz=hc(.078+.14*k,.095+.05*k,.085+.1*k);}else raz=hc(.078,.095,.085);
       ik(bar.arms[1],raz,v(.6,-.8,0));ik(bar.arms[0],hc(-.01,.31,-.02),v(-.6,-.6,-.3));};     if(A.wheel)A.wheel.rotation.x+=(C>=33&&C<39?dt*7:dt*Math.max(0,(A.wsp=(A.wsp||0)*.97)));
     if(C<30)shave(C%13);
     else if(C<33){const u=(C-30)/3;walkTo(P1,u,t,dt);}
     else if(C<39){stand(ESP,Math.atan2(EP.x-ESP.x,EP.z-ESP.z));bar.pose('idle',t);body.rotation.x=.18;bar.head.rotation.set(.35,0,0);A.wsp=7;
       const k=Math.sin(t*5)*.03;ik(bar.arms[1],toE(-.02,.66+.2,.13+k),v(.6,-.8,0));ik(bar.arms[0],toE(.42,.52+Math.sin(t*7)*.08,Math.cos(t*7)*.08),v(-.5,-.8,0));}   // navalha na pedra; a outra mão gira a manivela
     else if(C<42)walkTo(P1r,(C-39)/3,t,dt);
     else if(C<55)shave((C-42)%13);
     else if(C<58){walkTo(P2,(C-55)/3,t,dt);}
     else if(C<63){stand(BSP,Math.atan2(SUP.x-BSP.x,SUP.z-BSP.z));bar.pose('idle',t);body.rotation.x=.22;bar.head.rotation.set(.45,0,0);const k=(C-58)/5,w=Math.sin(k*Math.PI*3)*.05;   // procura frascos e pincel na caixa
       ik(bar.arms[1],v(SUP.x-.05+w,.86,SUP.z+.12),v(.6,-.8,0));ik(bar.arms[0],v(SUP.x+.12,.84,SUP.z+.2-w),v(-.6,-.8,0));}
     else if(C<66)walkTo(P2r,(C-63)/3,t,dt);
     else shave((C-66)%13);};
   A.anim(0,0);return A;};
 // ---------------- troca da cena antiga (mesmo lugar no Largo; missões, falas e controles preservados) ----------------
 {const bx=9,bz=-12,y=H(bx,bz);
  const near=(o,x,z,e=.06)=>Math.abs(o.position.x-x)<e&&Math.abs(o.position.z-z)<e;
  const i=FIGS.findIndex(f=>f.g&&near(f.g,bx+.8,bz-.1));
  if(i<0)V39.err.push('barbeiro antigo não encontrado');else{
    const old=FIGS[i];old.g.parent&&old.g.parent.remove(old.g);FIGS.splice(i,1);             // a cena nova tem controlador próprio (não entra em FIGS)
    for(const o of scene.children.slice()){if(o===old.g)continue;
      if(o.isGroup&&near(o,bx,bz,.03))scene.remove(o);                                       // freguês antigo
      else if(o.isMesh&&(near(o,bx,bz,.03)||near(o,bx-.6,bz+.7,.03)))scene.remove(o);}       // banquinho, suporte e bacia antigos
    const A=V39.scene();A.g.position.set(bx,y,bz);A.g.rotation.y=Math.PI/2;scene.add(A.g);V39.cena=A;A.anim(0,0);
    // colisões: o atendimento e o esmeril (o colisor antigo continua; acrescenta só o esmeril e o suporte)
    A.g.updateMatrixWorld(true);for(const k of['esmeril','suporte']){const p=new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixPosition(A.objects[k].matrixWorld);colliders.push({x:p.x,z:p.z,r:.42});}
    // o NPC de diálogo "Barbeiro · ofícios de cura" passa a ser este barbeiro (sem figura duplicada)
    const q=NPCS.find(n=>n.id==='barbeiroExtra');
    if(q&&q.f){const bp=new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixPosition(A.bar.g.matrixWorld);const ox=q.x,oz=q.z;q.f.g.parent&&q.f.g.parent.remove(q.f.g);
      const c=colliders.find(c=>c.r===.25&&Math.abs(c.x-ox)<.02&&Math.abs(c.z-oz)<.02);if(c){c.x=bp.x;c.z=bp.z;}
      q.x=bp.x;q.z=bp.z;q.mark.position.x=bp.x;q.mark.position.z=bp.z;q.f={g:new THREE.Group(),arms:[],legs:[],anim(){},gesture:0};V39.npc=q;}
    let lt=0;const vS=step;step=function(now){vS(now);if(inPalace)return;const t=now/1000,dt=Math.min(.1,t-(lt||t));lt=t;if(Math.hypot(camera.position.x-bx,camera.position.z-bz)>60)return;A.anim(dt,t);};}}
 V39.list.push('barbeiro');V39.ok=true;
}catch(e){V39.err.push(e&&e.stack||String(e));console.error(e);}

/*v33hook*/

 renderIntro();
})();
</script>


<div id="cameraHelp" style="position:fixed;bottom:8px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:6;background:#142c30e8;color:#f3e8cb;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:6px;font-size:13px;pointer-events:none;text-align:center">↑ / W: avançar · ↓ / S: recuar · ← → / A D: virar · V39 · Câmera acompanha por trás · Dona Rosa: atravesse a porta para entrar</div><script>
(()=>{
 const hud=document.getElementById('hud'),calendar=document.getElementById('calendar');
 const mobile=matchMedia('(max-width:600px)').matches;
 const menu=document.createElement('button');menu.id='menuMin';menu.type='button';menu.hidden=true;document.body.appendChild(menu);
 function foldMenu(fold){document.body.classList.toggle('menu-folded',fold);menu.textContent=fold?'Menu +':'Menu −';menu.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(!fold));menu.setAttribute('aria-label',fold?'Abrir menu e mapa':'Minimizar menu e mapa');}
 menu.onclick=()=>foldMenu(!document.body.classList.contains('menu-folded'));foldMenu(mobile);
 const clock=document.createElement('button');clock.id='calendarMin';clock.type='button';calendar.appendChild(clock);
 function foldClock(fold){calendar.classList.toggle('folded',fold);clock.textContent=fold?'+':'−';clock.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(!fold));clock.setAttribute('aria-label',fold?'Expandir relógio':'Minimizar relógio');}
 clock.onclick=()=>foldClock(!calendar.classList.contains('folded'));foldClock(mobile);
 if(mobile || innerWidth>=901){hud.classList.add('min');document.getElementById('hudMin').textContent='+';document.getElementById('hudMin').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');}
 const sync=()=>{menu.hidden=hud.hidden;};new MutationObserver(sync).observe(hud,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['hidden']});sync();
 for(const id of ['hudMin','cardMin']){const b=document.getElementById(id);b.addEventListener('click',()=>{b.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(!b.parentElement.classList.contains('min')));});}
 const help=document.getElementById('cameraHelp');help.onclick=()=>help.hidden=true;
})();
</script>
</body>
